Any failed check or bad reference makes the candidate not accepted; a duplicated id leaves neither copy typed.
respond returns exactly one of PASS, FAIL or REFUSED for every command; FAIL carries the report of a check that ran and did not hold.
version states the crate name, the crate version and the canon schema version, so a workflow can bind a run to the host that checked it.
boundaries: The host recomputes; it never trusts a value the caller supplies as the result.
